title: The 4 Best Strollers Under $400
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for strollers under $400, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at strollers under $400 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Baby Jogger City Mini GT2 Travel System
products.blurb: Key specs: Includes City GO 2 infant car seat, Forever-air rubber tires, never go flat, All-wheel suspension.
strengths: All-wheel suspension and flat-free tires outperform every other option in this list on rough terrain
One-hand fold and auto-lock genuinely speed up daily loading and unloading
Grows well past infancy, supporting a child up to 65 lbs
limitations: Wider footprint than compact strollers, less ideal for narrow doorways
No true bassinet or pram mode, relies on the included car seat for newborns
features: Includes City GO 2 infant car seat
Forever-air rubber tires, never go flat
All-wheel suspension
One-hand compact fold with auto-lock
Supports child up to 65 lbs

products.name: Chicco Bravo Trio Travel System
products.blurb: Key specs: Includes Chicco KeyFit 30 infant car seat and base, Click-in car seat with no adapter needed, One-hand, self-standing fold.
strengths: KeyFit 30 is one of the highest-rated infant car seats sold independently, a strong bundle value
No adapter required, the car seat clicks directly onto the stroller frame
Self-standing fold prevents tipping when folded in a trunk or hallway
limitations: 4-wheel suspension is smoother than budget models but not as capable off pavement as the City Mini GT2's all-wheel system
Heavier once the car seat is attached than stroller-only options
Toddler seat reclines deeply but isn't a true flat pram mode
features: Includes Chicco KeyFit 30 infant car seat and base
Click-in car seat with no adapter needed
One-hand, self-standing fold
4-wheel suspension
UPF 50+ canopy with peekaboo mesh window

products.name: Graco Modes Pramette Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: True pram mode with flat-lying reversible seat, 3-in-1: car seat carrier, pramette, toddler stroller, One-hand fold.
strengths: Reversible seat lets a newborn face the parent, a preferred orientation early on
One-hand fold speeds up daily use for solo parents
limitations: Car seat sold separately on the stroller-only version
Pram mode compartment is smaller than a dedicated bassinet attachment like the UPPAbaby Vista V2's
Storage basket is smaller than the City Mini GT2 or Bravo Trio
features: True pram mode with flat-lying reversible seat
3-in-1: car seat carrier, pramette, toddler stroller
One-hand fold
Removable child tray with cup holders
Compatible with Graco SnugRide infant car seats

products.name: BOB Gear Revolution Flex 3.0 Jogging Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: Swivel-locking front wheel, Mountain-bike-style suspension with air-filled tires, Adjustable handlebar.
strengths: Real suspension and air-filled tires deliver a noticeably smoother ride than any non-jogging stroller in this list
Swivel-locking front wheel supports both running and everyday maneuverability
Adjustable handlebar fits multiple parent heights
limitations: No car seat included, this is stroller-only
Larger folded footprint than travel systems and compact strollers
Air-filled tires require occasional inflation, unlike foam-filled wheels
